description:
In a society where euthanasia has become a part of everyday life, twenty-four-year-old Daru decides to die.

However, before he can do so, he must spend a month in a sleep-like state, confronting his past…

As he finally faces Tan again, a mysterious figure known only as “J” intervenes, and Daru’s memories begin to take a new direction.

*A revised edition of the popular series, newly edited and with updated artwork.*
